data.title: Pizza Boss old-master still life
data.creativeFamily: editorial food still life, absurd functional tool
data.audience: Pinterest users who save pizza ideas, kitchen styling, unusual cooking tools, and deadpan visual humor
data.hook: A beautiful old-master pizza still life becomes strange when the cutting wheel resolves as a compact blue-and-gray circular saw.

product.name: Genuine Fred PIZZA BOSS 3000 pizza cutter (ASIN B001XSFW42)

references.lesson: Preserve one compact blue front housing, gray rear/top handle, single smooth stainless cutting wheel with center fastener, broad gray lower guard, ordinary six-inch scale, and manual pizza-wheel function; never render a powered construction saw, extra blade, teeth, cord, battery, or sparks.

notes: Three product-derived concepts with stop feature, click feature, exact feature, fidelity risk, and swap test are recorded in the v9 README.
This ASIN and pizza-cutter visual mechanism have not appeared in a public Goose Gifts Pin.
